description: Conference pulse for the organizer. Reads meeting metadata only (index roloe-meetings: no passages, no names, no content). Returns one row per hour for the last `hours_back` hours: meetings, counts by kind (pair, guest, same_person), how many got at least one finding, median seconds to findings, how many reached a passing Try it, and median seconds to help.

configuration.query: FROM roloe-meetings | WHERE DATE_DIFF("minute", started_at, NOW()) <= ?hours_back * 60 | EVAL hour = DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, started_at) | STATS meetings = COUNT(*), pair = COUNT(*) WHERE kind == "pair", guest = COUNT(*) WHERE kind == "guest", same_person = COUNT(*) WHERE kind == "same_person", with_findings = COUNT(*) WHERE findings_accepted > 0, median_time_to_findings_s = MEDIAN(time_to_findings_s), try_passed = COUNT(*) WHERE try_state == "passed", median_time_to_help_s = MEDIAN(time_to_help_s) BY hour | SORT hour ASC | LIMIT 48

hours_back.description: How many hours back from now to include. Defaults to 24 (today).
